label: JSON
headline: JSON Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for JSON — data types, syntax rules, escape sequences, objects, arrays, and JavaScript parse/stringify patterns.

items.name: String
items.definition: A sequence of Unicode characters wrapped in double quotes. Single quotes are NOT valid in JSON.

items.name: Number (integer)
items.definition: A whole number. Can be positive or negative. Hexadecimal (0xFF) is NOT allowed.

items.name: Number (decimal)
items.definition: A floating-point number with a decimal fraction.

items.name: Number (exponent)
items.definition: Scientific notation using e, e+, e-, E, E+, or E.

items.name: Boolean
items.definition: Lowercase only. true or false — no quotes, no capitals.

items.name: Null
items.definition: Represents an empty or non-existent value. Lowercase only.

items.name: Object
items.definition: An unordered collection of key/value pairs wrapped in curly braces. Keys must be strings.

items.name: Array
items.definition: An ordered list of values wrapped in square brackets. Values can be any JSON type.

items.name: Basic object
items.definition: Key/value pairs separated by commas. Keys must be double-quoted strings.

items.name: Nested object
items.definition: Objects can contain other objects as values.

items.name: Empty object
items.definition: A valid JSON object with no properties.

items.name: Mixed types
items.definition: Values in one object can be different types.

items.name: Basic array
items.definition: An ordered list of values. Begins with [ and ends with ].

items.name: Mixed array
items.definition: Arrays can contain values of different types.

items.name: Array of objects
items.definition: A common pattern — each element is an object, great for lists of records.

items.name: Object of arrays
items.definition: An object whose property value is an array.

items.name: 2D array
items.definition: Arrays can nest other arrays to create multi-dimensional structures.

items.name: Empty array
items.definition: A valid JSON array with no elements.

items.name: Double quote
items.definition: Escape a literal double quote inside a JSON string.

items.name: Backslash
items.definition: Escape a literal backslash inside a JSON string.

items.name: Forward slash
items.definition: Optionally escape a forward slash — useful in HTML contexts.

items.name: Newline
items.definition: Insert a line break inside a string value.

items.name: Carriage return
items.definition: Insert a carriage return inside a string value.

items.name: Tab
items.definition: Insert a horizontal tab inside a string value.

items.name: Backspace
items.definition: Insert a backspace character inside a string value.

items.name: Form feed
items.definition: Insert a form feed character inside a string value.

items.name: Unicode
items.definition: Insert a Unicode character using \u followed by exactly four hex digits. Example: \u0041 = 'A'.

items.name: Parse string → object
items.definition: Converts a JSON string into a JavaScript object. Throws SyntaxError if the string is invalid JSON.

items.name: Stringify object → string
items.definition: Converts a JavaScript object into a JSON string.

items.name: Pretty print
items.definition: Third argument sets indentation (2 or 4 spaces). Produces human-readable output.

items.name: Replacer filter
items.definition: Second argument can be an array of keys to include, or a function to transform values.

items.name: Reviver function
items.definition: Second argument to JSON.parse — a function called for each key/value to transform the result.

items.name: Deep clone
items.definition: A simple way to deep-copy a plain object. Does NOT work for functions, Dates, or undefined values.

items.name: Dot notation
items.definition: Access an object property by name. Returns undefined for missing properties.

items.name: Bracket notation
items.definition: Access a property using a string key. Required when the key contains spaces or special characters.

items.name: Nested object
items.definition: Chain dot notation to drill into nested objects.

items.name: Array index
items.definition: Access the first element of an array. Arrays are zero-indexed.

items.name: Array of objects
items.definition: Access the name property of the second element in an array of objects.

items.name: Optional chaining
items.definition: Safely access nested properties — returns undefined instead of throwing if a middle value is null/undefined.

items.name: Single quotes
items.definition: All strings in JSON must use double quotes. Single quotes are not allowed.

items.name: Trailing comma
items.definition: JSON does not allow trailing commas after the last property or element.

items.name: Unquoted key
items.definition: Object keys must always be double-quoted strings.

items.name: Hex number
items.definition: Only decimal numeric literals are allowed. Hexadecimal, octal, and binary are not valid JSON.

items.name: Undefined
items.definition: undefined is not a JSON type. Use null instead.

items.name: Comments
items.definition: JSON has no comment syntax. Use a separate documentation field if needed.
